triage.title: AI Symptom Triage & Specialist Finder
triage.subtitle: Type or speak your symptoms in English, Bangla, or Banglish
triage.placeholder: e.g., 'Severe chest pain and shortness of breath' or 'buke khub betha ar shash kosto'...
triage.emergencyDesc: Based on your reported symptoms, please call 999 or visit the nearest Emergency Room immediately.
triage.urgentDesc: Your symptoms warrant prompt evaluation by a specialist doctor within 12-24 hours.
triage.routineDesc: Schedule a teleconsultation or visit a specialist doctor at your earliest convenience.
triage.selfCareDesc: Your symptoms appear mild. Rest, hydrate, and monitor. Consult if symptoms worsen.
triage.disclaimer: AI Triage is for guidance only and does not replace official medical advice.
